intro.zh: 春城昆明 — 石林、滇池与多彩民族文化。全年温和气候与丰富云南少数民族文化。

culture.en: The City of Eternal Spring — Stone Forest, Dian Lake & Minority Cultures. Year-round mild climate and rich Yunnan ethnic diversity.
culture.zh: 春城昆明 — 石林、滇池与多彩民族文化。全年温和气候与丰富云南少数民族文化。

climate.en: Mild "Spring City" climate year-round (15-25°C). Best in Mar-May for flowers, Sep-Nov for clear skies.
climate.zh: 四季如春（15-25°C）。3-5月赏花、9-11月天晴最佳。

transit.en: Metro lines 1-6 plus buses; Changshui Airport 25km from center.
transit.zh: 地铁1-6号线加公交；长水机场距市中心25公里。

intercity.en: High-speed rail from Dali (~2h), Lijiang (~3h), Guilin.
intercity.zh: 大理高铁约2小时、丽江约3小时、桂林可达。

tips.en: Base yourself here for Yunnan trips; sunscreen is a must at altitude.
tips.zh: 作为云南旅行中转站；高原紫外线强需防晒。
